Watch Aye Mr. Minor sung by Haricharan & Shashaa Tirupati for Kaaviyathalaivan. Aye Mr. Minor is beautiful love ballad. The song features Siddharth & Anaika and is reminiscent of the era of the 40's.
Video Name - Aye Mr. Minor
Movie - Kaaviyathalaivan
Singer - Haricharan & Shashaa Tirupati
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Pa. Vijay
Director - Vasanthabalan
Starring - Siddharth, Prithviraj, Vedhika, Anaika
